Method of Attack: Escaping container confinement using the chroot command
Deploying interconnected payloads from a command-and-control server
Establishing persistence and backdooring the host
Discoverer: Cado Security researchers Nate Bill and Matt Muir
Attack Vector: Reconnaissance of active services such as 'ys-kernel-debugger', 'gsc', 'c3pool_miner', and 'dockercache'
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of cryptocurrency mining software like XMRig
Unconventional file storage locations such as /dev/shm
Shell scripts creating backdoors, adding SSH keys, and establishing rogue user accounts
